relations.evidence: śrīśrīnepāleśvara giriṃdra jagajjayamalla devayāta śrīśivarāma akurama viyā julo

purpose: śrīśrīnepāleśvara giriṃdra jagajjayamalla devayāta ... viyā julo
notes: The Newari phrase 'cotakasyaṃ cosyaṃ' indicates causing the copy to be written / having copied it. The manuscript was given ('viyā julo') to King Jagajjayamalla of Kathmandu. The reading 'akurama' after 'śrīśivarāma' may represent a second personal name (e.g. Akrūra), a patronymic/family name, or an uncorrected scribal error.
